contamination: Known contamination: Laya's and ModernBERT's pretraining text may include PubMed pages; reader v1's text excludes every PubMedQA article by PMID and by the 13-word check, and the task round, which would have read the contexts of session 4's PubMedQA training items, was not kept; BioClinical's reader was trained on PubMed and PMC, PubMedQA's articles included. Session 4's notes on Duan stand: PubMedQA contexts are PubMed abstracts that PubMed-trained readers may have seen with their conclusions; Duan trained on 445 PQA-L items that may overlap the official test list, and on a random 20,000-encounter UCI sample that may overlap our test split. Both favor Duan.

1.rule: ECE at most the limit on each question (the larger of 0.05 and the 95th percentile of a calibrated model's ECE, fixed in release_candidate.json before any test prediction)

2.rule: log loss below the prior's on both questions, 95 percent interval of the difference excluding zero

3.rule: in D2, macro-F1 not below Duan's point estimate (top answer on the PubMedQA yes or no items; for readmission, decision weights fitted on the validation split as in session 4's correction 3), Duan on its own wording

4.rule: PubMedQA log loss lower than v0.1's, the 95 percent interval of the difference (v0.2 minus v0.1) wholly below zero, and readmission log loss not significantly worse than v0.1's (the interval's lower end at or below zero)
